text: {"action": "reply", "content": "The general return policy for vacuum cleaners is that an order can only be returned if its status is 'delivered'. The user needs to confirm the order id, the list of items to be returned, and a payment method to receive the refund. The refund must either go to the original payment method, or an existing gift card. After confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'return requested', and the user will receive an email regarding how to return items."}
